certificationScope: non-certifying exact source-only ARM64 package and live VM smoke receipt with clean fresh daemon and CLI payloads
sourceDescription: Source-only Linux parity follow-up containing mission snapshot retention, duplicate SmartHub probe prevention, Mission Inspect logs wiring, Activity import routing, and bracketed Avahi-discovered IPv6 endpoints; the daemon and CLI were cleanly rebuilt from the source payload before packaging.

environment.session: Unlocked GNOME session 1; active-window capture used the session X authority and D-Bus bus
environment.webkitNote: WebKitGTK WebGL2 is unavailable in this UTM guest; the shell visibly selects its Canvas2D fallback and labels the limitation.

sourceBuild.payloadNote: Fresh daemon and CLI outputs were staged first and matched by SHA-256; the final Tauri bundle reused that verified staged payload after the guest cargo path was restored.

backdrop.captureNote: The VM session was unlocked before launch verification. scrot -u captured the active OpenBurnBar window; installed daemon and CLI hashes match clean fresh Swift outputs and the explicit staged payload inputs. The desktop process was restarted after package installation.

backgroundRecovery.reason: Minimize/restore was not part of this bounded capture.

limitations: The package is locally built and unsigned; it is not release provenance evidence.
The clean unlocked launch proves the exact ARM64 package renders on Ubuntu GNOME/X11, but does not certify every route, onboarding interaction, accessibility matrix, or full visual parity.
This guest does not certify WebGL2-only kernels, KDE/Wayland/wlroots, x86_64, or cross-device workflows.

The focused Linux gateway test target compiled on the guest but its executable link was blocked by the VM Swift 6.1 toolchain's missing swift::threading::fatal symbol; host execution remains blocked by the existing SQLCipher.framework rpath issue.
The strict ledger remains 0/40 product requirements and 0/7 environment receipts.
The final Tauri packaging invocation reused a staged payload only after the staged daemon/CLI hashes were verified against the clean fresh outputs; this does not replace a signed release build.
